display.title: Audio Playback Position Reports Test
display.description: Test scene for the AudioEvent playback-position reports (tickNumber, currentOffset, clipLength) written by the renderer while an AudioSource plays. Covers audioEventsSystem.registerAudioPlaybackEntity / removeAudioPlaybackEntity (push), getAudioPlayback (pull), the lag computation against a per-tick scene clock versus the naive processing-time clock, seek landing, loop wrap, and that registerAudioEventsEntity still fires only on media-state changes.
